title: Broadcast gate skips rich-body spans and edits
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 Message/set: a create 'that includes any broadcast mention — a non-empty broadcastMentions array, or a rich-body body containing one or more "broadcast" spans — MUST be rejected with forbidden' in a channel without mention_broadcast; updates that 'add or retain' one likewise. message.rs:527 (create) and :996-1000/:1063 (update) only check the broadcastMentions array, which MUST be empty for rich bodies (:356), so rich-body broadcasts and body-only edits bypass the gate. Found by the 1e33ec7 audit (wf_af4656ea-dbb, both refuters upheld). Fix with a failing test quoting the draft; extend chat_client_wire.rs where the client exercises it.
close_reason: Fixed against jmap-chat-spec 1e33ec7; test-first, reviewed, gates green (stable/beta/1.88)
